title.zh: 容器是如何把一个进程关进沙盒的

desc.zh: 一行 docker run 就能起一个看似独立的 Linux 系统，但 Linux 内核源码里根本没有「容器」这个结构体。这篇按 OCI Image 1.1 / Runtime 1.2 规范与 Linux 6.x 内核原语，把这一行命令拆开：OCI 镜像层与 SHA-256 ChainID 去重，OverlayFS 的写时复制与 .wh. 白化文件，八副 Namespaces 与 Rootless UserNS 映射，veth、bridge 与 NAT，cgroups v2 的 CPU 节流与统一内存 OOM，seccomp-bpf 与 Capabilities 边界，PID 1 信号与僵尸进程回收，以及截至 2026 年 11 月的 MicroVM、EROFS 与 WASI 0.3 前沿。九个可动手模型全部对照规范与 Node SHA-256 逐项验证。
desc.en: One docker run line spawns what looks like a fresh Linux box, yet there is no "container" struct anywhere in the Linux kernel. Following OCI Image 1.1 / Runtime 1.2 specs and Linux 6.x primitives, this essay takes that command apart: OCI layer SHA-256 ChainID deduplication, OverlayFS copy-up and .wh. whiteouts, eight Linux namespaces and Rootless UserNS UID mapping, veth bridges and NAT, cgroups v2 CPU throttling and unified memory OOM, seccomp-bpf and capabilities, PID 1 signals and zombie reaping, plus November 2026 frontiers in MicroVMs, EROFS, and WASI 0.3. Nine hands-on models cross-checked against Node crypto and exact spec arithmetic.

title.zh: 容器不是虚拟机：共享内核的受限进程
title.en: Containers are constrained host processes, not VMs

desc.zh: Linux 内核里没有容器结构体，docker run 通过 containerd-shim 和 runc 为普通进程挂上 Namespaces、cgroups v2、OverlayFS 与 seccomp 边界，与自带访客内核的虚拟机截然不同。
desc.en: The Linux kernel has no container object; docker run invokes containerd-shim and runc to wrap a regular process with Namespaces, cgroups v2, OverlayFS, and seccomp while sharing one host kernel.

title.zh: OCI 镜像层与 ChainID 去重
title.en: OCI image layers and ChainID deduplication

desc.zh: OCI 镜像用 Image Index、Manifest 和 Config 按 SHA-256 串联多层只读 tar，通过 ChainID 递推哈希实现底层复用；改动越靠前，上方缓存失效越多。
desc.en: OCI images chain read-only tar layers under an Index, Manifest, and Config using SHA-256 ChainIDs; base layers are stored once on disk while lower mutations invalidate upper caches.

zh: 为什么镜像可以共享磁盘

title.zh: OverlayFS 的 Copy-Up 与白化删除

desc.zh: OverlayFS 把只读 lowerdir 和可写 upperdir 合并为根目录；修改或 chmod 大文件会触发整文件 Copy-Up，后一层 rm 只写 .wh. 遮罩却删不掉下层字节。
desc.en: OverlayFS merges read-only lowerdirs with a writable upperdir; modifying or chmodding a lower file copies the whole file up, while deleting across layers creates .wh. whiteouts without freeing lower bytes.

zh: 为什么 docker rm 镜像没变小
en: why deleting files in Dockerfile stays large

title.zh: Linux Namespaces 与 Rootless UID 映射
title.en: Linux Namespaces and Rootless UID mapping

desc.zh: 八种 Namespace 只过滤进程看到的资源编号：必须重挂 /proc 才看不见宿主机进程，只有开启 USER Namespace 的 uid_map 才能把容器内 UID 0 映成无特权的宿主机 UID。
desc.en: Linux namespaces filter process views without cloning the kernel: /proc must be remounted under MNT+PID to hide host processes, and UserNS uid_map maps container UID 0 to unprivileged host UIDs.

zh: 为什么容器里还要挂载 proc

title.zh: 容器网络：veth pair、网桥与 VXLAN MTU
title.en: Container networking: veth, bridge, NAT, and MTU

desc.zh: 独立 NET Namespace 通过跨墙的 veth 虚拟网线接入宿主机 docker0 网桥和 nftables NAT；叠加 50 字节 VXLAN 隧道头后需将容器 MTU 降到 1450 B。
desc.en: An isolated NET namespace connects via a veth pair to a host bridge and nftables NAT; adding 50-byte VXLAN encapsulation requires lowering container MTU to 1450 B, which eBPF host-routing accelerates.

zh: 容器 VXLAN MTU 分片

title.zh: cgroups v2 CPU 带宽节流与毛刺
title.en: cgroups v2 CPU throttling and tail stalls

desc.zh: --cpus=0.5 对应每 100 ms 给 50 ms 额度；多线程运行时在多核上只需 12.5 ms 就会耗尽额度并全员冻结 87.5 ms，造成严重的尾延迟毛刺。
desc.en: A 0.5-CPU limit grants 50 ms of CPU quota per 100 ms period; multi-threaded runtimes burn that quota in 12.5 ms on four cores and stall all threads for the remaining 87.5 ms.

zh: 容器 CPU 没跑满却卡顿
en: why low CPU container spikes latency

title.zh: cgroups v2 统一内存、页缓存与 OOM Kill
title.en: cgroups v2 unified memory, PSI, and OOM kill

desc.zh: cgroups v2 将堆内存、tmpfs 与文件页缓存统一记入 memory.current；越过 memory.high 先淘汰可回收页缓存产生 PSI 停顿，不可回收内存撞破 memory.max 立刻触发 OOM-kill。
desc.en: cgroups v2 bills heap, tmpfs, and file page cache to one memory.current counter: crossing memory.high triggers PSI reclaim stalls, while unreclaimable memory hitting memory.max fires OOM-kill.

title.zh: Capabilities 与 seccomp-bpf 安全边界

desc.zh: 容器默认通过 NoNewPrivs、seccomp-bpf 白名单（放行约 330 个、拦截 44 个高危系统调用）、Capabilities 裁剪（剥掉 CAP_SYS_ADMIN）与 AppArmor/SELinux 四道闸门收敛共享内核攻击面。
desc.en: Containers restrict the shared syscall table through four gates: NoNewPrivs, seccomp-bpf (~330 allowed, 44 blocked), Linux Capabilities (dropping CAP_SYS_ADMIN), and AppArmor/SELinux MAC policies.

title.zh: 容器里的 PID 1：信号忽略与僵尸回收
title.en: Container PID 1: ignored signals and zombie reaping

desc.zh: 内核对未注册处理器的 PID 1 忽略默认 SIGTERM 动作，且所有孤儿孙进程都挂到 PID 1 名下等待 wait() 回收；Shell 写法易卡满 10 秒遭 SIGKILL 强杀，--init (tini) 同时解决两件事。
desc.en: The kernel suppresses default SIGTERM termination for PID 1 and reparents orphans to it: shell-form CMD stalls 10 s until SIGKILL (exit 137) and leaks zombies unless exec-form plus a reaper or tini (--init) runs.

zh: Dockerfile CMD shell 和 exec 区别

title.zh: 前沿沙盒与镜像演化：ID-map、MicroVM、EROFS 与 WASI 0.3
title.en: Container frontiers: idmapped mounts, MicroVMs, EROFS, and WASI 0.3

desc.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月的容器演进：Linux idmapped 挂载免去 chown 复制，Firecracker/Kata MicroVM 用硬件虚拟化隔离不可信租户，EROFS/Nydus 按需懒加载镜像，WASI 0.3 推进原生异步 Wasm 沙盒。
desc.en: As of November 2026, idmapped mounts avoid chown Copy-Up, Firecracker/Kata MicroVMs isolate untrusted tenants with separate guest kernels, EROFS/Nydus stream layers on demand, and WASI 0.3 brings async Wasm sandboxes.
